CREATE TABLE dhmis_control.organizations (
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	schema_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	region VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	visibility VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	adapters JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (schema_name)
)
tenant:
CREATE TABLE tenant.audit_events (
	action VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	resource VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	resource_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	details JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.locations (
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	timezone VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	chairs JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.outbox_messages (
	kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.services (
	code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	fee_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (fee_cents >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (code)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.staff_users (
	email VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	token_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (email)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.patients (
	first_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	last_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	birth_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	allergies JSON NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.appointments (
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	provider_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	chair VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	starts_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	ends_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	procedure VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(25) NOT NULL, 
	cancellation_reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT appointment_positive_duration CHECK (ends_at > starts_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES tenant.staff_users (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_tenant_appointments_starts_at ON tenant.appointments (starts_at)

CREATE TABLE tenant.chart_entries (
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tooth INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	surface VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	condition VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	notes VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.consents (
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	template_version VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	certificate JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.invoices (
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	lines JSON NOT NULL, 
	total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	paid_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (total_cents >= 0 AND paid_cents >= 0 AND paid_cents <= total_cents), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.perio_exams (
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	measurements JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.claims (
	invoice_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	network VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	covered_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (invoice_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id) REFERENCES tenant.invoices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.ledger_entries (
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	invoice_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id) REFERENCES tenant.invoices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)
